author: Alexander Newby
title: Let's Roll Press is looking for Artists
content:
**Let's Roll Press is looking for Artists**

About Let's Roll Press: We're the people behind Chapelwick, the cosmic horror campaign that launched on Kickstarter last year. We're expanding our art team to accelerate development.

The Role: We're looking for a few talented artists to create professional illustrations for our Campaign Setting. New illustration batches are commissioned as each batch is completed.

What We're Looking For: Strong portfolio demonstrating TTRPG or fantasy illustration experience; ability to work from detailed creative briefs, maintain visual consistency across series, and accommodate art direction and revisions; proficiency with digital art tools; fast turnaround without sacrificing quality; professional communication and reliable delivery. Bonus: Experience with both 2D and 3D workflows; familiarity with Elden Ring, Bloodborne, Dark Souls, etc.

Expectations: Professional design and execution of character, environment, and/or encounter illustrations; ability to interpret detailed briefs and ask questions before starting; reliable monthly deadlines.

Terms: Independent contractor basis (1099); $275–$650+ per illustration; commissions paid via PayPal only; ongoing collaboration opportunities.

To apply: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/3jtz31vMRz
